document.title: North Slope Borough, Alaska, General Obligation Bonds, Series 2022A (General Purpose), 2022B (Schools) and 2022C (Public Housing): Official Statement

claims.text: North Slope Borough, Alaska is selling three series of general obligation bonds: $71,530,000 Series 2022A (General Purpose), $9,165,000 Series 2022B (Schools) and $13,790,000 Series 2022C (Public Housing).

cites.quote: the sale of its $71,530,000 North Slope Borough, Alaska, General Obligation Bonds, Series 2022A (General Purpose)
its $9,165,000 North Slope Borough, Alaska, General Obligation Bonds, Series 2022B (Schools)
its $13,790,000 North Slope Borough, Alaska, General Obligation Bonds, Series 2022C (Public Housing)

claims.text: Total par across the three series is $94,485,000.

cites.quote: the sale of its $71,530,000 North Slope Borough

claims.text: The final official statement is dated October 26, 2022. Delivery is expected on or about November 15, 2022.

cites.quote: October 26, 2022
on or about November 15, 2022

claims.text: KeyBanc Capital Markets Inc. is the underwriter and has agreed to buy all three series, subject to conditions.

cites.quote: KeyBanc Capital Markets, Inc. (the "Underwriter"), has agreed, subject to certain conditions precedent, to purchase the 2022A Bonds

claims.text: Working group: JD Capital Markets LLC (Seattle) is municipal advisor, Hawkins Delafield & Wood LLP is bond and disclosure counsel, Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP is underwriter's counsel, and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. is paying agent and registrar.

cites.quote: The Borough has utilized the services of JD Capital Markets LLC, Seattle, Washington, as municipal advisor
Hawkins Delafield & Wood LLP, Disclosure Counsel to the Borough
passed upon for the Underwriter by its counsel, Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP
The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., San Francisco, California, as Paying Agent and Registrar

claims.text: Unlimited-tax GO pledge: the Borough pledges its full faith and credit and must levy property taxes without limit as to rate or amount to pay the bonds.

cites.quote: the full faith and credit of the Borough are pledged to the payment of the principal of and interest on the 2022 Bonds
without limitation as to rate or amount

claims.text: The Borough's Permanent Fund (about $961.8 million on June 30, 2022) cannot be used to pay debt service.

cites.quote: The Borough's Charter prohibits the use of the Borough's Permanent Fund and income transferred from the Permanent Fund to the General Fund to pay debt service on the 2022 Bonds
On June 30, 2022, the value of the Permanent Fund was approximately $961.8 million.

claims.text: Alaska municipalities can't currently file for Chapter 9 bankruptcy, and Borough Code requires all oil and gas property taxes to go to a debt service account.

cites.quote: are not currently authorized by state law to file for voluntary bankruptcy under Chapter 9 of the United States Bankruptcy Code
all oil and gas property taxes levied under AS 29.45.100 are required to be appropriated to a debt service account within the General Fund

claims.text: Voters approved the bond ordinances on October 4, 2022, and the Assembly adopted the authorizing resolution on October 11, 2022.

cites.quote: approved by the qualified voters of the Borough at an election held on October 4, 2022
adopted by the Borough Assembly on October 11, 2022

claims.text: Proceeds fund capital projects under ten bond ordinances authorizing $101,970,000, led by water facilities ($22,470,000), general capital projects ($20,745,000) and public housing ($14,395,000).

cites.quote: 2022-05 Water Facilities 22,470,000
2022-11 General Capital Projects 20,745,000
2022-04 Public Housing 14,395,000

claims.text: All maturities carry 5.00% coupons. Serial maturities run 2023 to 2033: 2022A matures 2026 to 2029, 2022B 2023 to 2033, and 2022C 2023 to 2026.
Yields run from 3.230% in 2023 to 3.920% in 2033. The large 2022A maturities price at 3.440% (2026) to 3.600% (2029).
No call: the bonds are not subject to redemption before maturity.

cites.quote: The 2022 Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to maturity.
The 2022 Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturity dates.

claims.text: Interest is paid June 30 and December 30, starting June 30, 2023. Denominations are $5,000.

cites.quote: Interest on the 2022 Bonds will be payable on each June 30 and December 30, commencing on June 30, 2023.
denominations of $5,000

claims.text: Tax-exempt and not an AMT preference item. For tax years after December 31, 2022, interest counts toward adjusted financial statement income for certain corporations subject to the AMT.

cites.quote: interest on the 2022 Bonds is excluded from gross income for Federal income tax purposes
however for tax years beginning after December 31, 2022, interest on the Series 2022 Bonds is included in the "adjusted financial statement income" of certain corporations

claims.text: Debt service on this issue totals $118,388,406. It peaks at $24,653,750 to $25,663,250 a year in fiscal 2027 to 2029, then falls to $1,134,000 by 2033.
The 2022 Bonds are rated AA by S&P, AA by Fitch and AA+ by Kroll.

cites.quote: S&P Global Ratings ("S&P") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA"; Fitch Ratings Inc. ("Fitch") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA" and Kroll Bond Rating Agency, Inc. ("Kroll") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA+."

claims.text: The Moody's Aa2 listed in the audited financial statements (Appendix D) is not a rating on these bonds. The Ratings section names only S&P, Fitch and Kroll.

cites.quote: Moody's Investors Service Aa2
Such ratings reflect only the views of S&P, Fitch and Kroll.

claims.text: Sources are par plus original issue premium of $5,115,226.50 (2022A), $649,515.40 (2022B) and $423,433.75 (2022C).

Uses are deposits to the capital projects funds ($76,136,000.00, $9,749,000.00 and $14,115,000.00) and costs of issuance ($509,226.50, $65,515.40 and $98,433.75). Costs of issuance include the underwriter's discount.

cites.quote: Deposit to Capital Projects Funds 76,136,000.00 9,749,000.00 14,115,000.00
Underwriter's discount; and other costs related to issuance of the 2022 Bonds.

claims.text: Underwriter's discount totals $187,622.30 across the three series, about $1.99 per $1,000 of par.

cites.quote: less underwriter's discount of $142,039.72
less underwriter's discount of $18,199.28
less underwriter's discount of $27,383.30

claims.text: After this issue the Borough will have $296,580,000 of GO bonds outstanding and no authorized but unissued GO bonds.

cites.quote: Total Outstanding General Obligation Bonds $296,580,000
The Borough will have no authorized but unissued general obligation bonds immediately after the issuance of the 2022 Bonds.

claims.text: Net GO debt is 1.35% of the $21,982,877,719 assessed value as of January 1, 2022, or $18,655 per resident (population 15,898).

cites.quote: Net General Obligation Debt as a Percentage of Assessed Valuation 1.35%
Assessed Valuation as of January 1, 2022(2), (4) $21,982,877,719
Net General Obligation Debt Per Capita (4) $18,655
Population as of January 18, 2022(3) 15,898

claims.text: The tax base is almost all oil and gas: about 95% of assessed value. Hilcorp/Harvest (36.5%) and ConocoPhillips (31.6%) pay over two-thirds of the levy, and the top ten taxpayers pay 94.4%.

cites.quote: approximately 95% ($21.0 billion) of the January 1, 2022 total $22.0 Billion Assessed Value is from oil and gas industry companies
Hilcorp/Harvest Oil and Gas Producer $8,028,978,070 $144,441,315 36.5%
Conoco Phillips AK Co Oil and Gas Producer 6,941,462,750 124,876,915 31.6

claims.text: The tax falls on oil and gas property, not production, so oil prices and output affect the base only indirectly.

cites.quote: the sales price and level of production of oil and gas do not directly affect the Borough's property tax base

claims.text: Taxes levied for GO debt service sit outside the statutory and Charter tax limits.

cites.quote: property taxes levied or pledged to pay or secure the payment of the principal and interest on general obligation bonds are not subject to the limitations described above

claims.text: Collections are steady: 99.55% of the FY 2021 levy was collected in the current year, at a 17.99 mill rate.

cites.quote: Percent of Levy Collected 99.38% 99.34% 99.62% 99.23% 99.55%

claims.text: $4,889,000 of 2022A proceeds go to the Barrow Seawall Project, where the Borough's share is currently 35%, about $174 million of an estimated $497 million.

cites.quote: $4,889,000 of the proceeds of the 2022A Bonds will be applied to acquire easements required for, and pay other costs of, the Barrow Seawall Project
The Borough's share of the cost of the Barrow Seawall Project is currently 35% or approximately $174 million
approximately $497 million with an expected completion date of 2028/29

sections.title: Comp profile

cites.quote: the sale of its $71,530,000 North Slope Borough
its $9,165,000 North Slope Borough
its $13,790,000 North Slope Borough

claims.text: Maturities: serial 2023 to 2033, with the weight in the 2022A maturities of 2027 ($20,250,000), 2028 ($21,810,000) and 2029 ($23,360,000).
Tax status: all three series are tax-exempt, with no taxable piece, so the comps are tax-exempt.

cites.quote: interest on the 2022 Bonds is excluded from gross income for Federal income tax purposes

claims.text: Sale method: KeyBanc, as underwriter, buys each series at a set purchase price. The OS has no notice of sale or bid results.

cites.quote: has agreed, subject to certain conditions precedent, to purchase the 2022A Bonds, if any are purchased, at a price of $76,503,186.78

claims.text: State: Alaska. It isn't one of the states that trade on their own curve (California and New York, for example), so the comp pool is national.

cites.quote: provides information relating to the North Slope Borough, Alaska (the "Borough")

claims.text: Ratings: AA (S&P), AA (Fitch) and AA+ (Kroll), so look at comps rated about AA- to AA+ and widen if the list is thin.

cites.quote: S&P Global Ratings ("S&P") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA"; Fitch Ratings Inc. ("Fitch") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA" and Kroll Bond Rating Agency, Inc. ("Kroll") has rated the 2022 Bonds "AA+."

claims.text: Security: unlimited-tax GO. GO comps come first, but a revenue deal of similar size and maturities can still work.

cites.quote: without limitation as to rate or amount

claims.text: Call terms: none. These bonds can't be redeemed early, so record each comp's call terms, since a callable comp isn't a like-for-like yield.

cites.quote: The 2022 Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to maturity.

sections.note: Search this implies (EMMA or the desk's own platform): negotiated, tax-exempt new issues that priced the same week, of similar size (about $94.5 million) and maturities (2023 to 2033, weighted to 2027 to 2029), rated about AA- to AA+, outside the states that trade on their own curve, GO first. Then open each candidate's official statement and confirm its maturity schedule before it goes in the comp set.
